name: Kenji Hayakawa
want: keep the family comfortable and see his children happy
secret: He has been told he may be posted to a branch office in Osaka for a year, living apart from the family, and hasn't found a way to say it.
voice: Puns, then laughs alone; says "well, well" when worried.
description: Commutes to the prefectural office in Kasahara by bus. Takes too many photos.
appearance: Thinning hair, a cardigan at home and the same grey suit at work, a camera around his neck on special days.
